preregistered.bgk_failure: kinetic energy >20*initial, nonpositive density, or unsafe/nonfinite populations
preregistered.mrt_stability: rho in [0.5,1.5], speed<0.5, energy<=1.05*initial at all checkpoints
preregistered.roofline: logical 304 bytes/update divided by measured large-copy bandwidth; memory roof only, not a hardware-counter full roofline

throughput.scope: warm synchronized host-launched steps, excludes setup/readback; no graph; includes collision, quantization, streaming; copy roof only
